_doc: Shock cards (ODD §7.10, ADR 0009). Effects are ASSUMED magnitudes for gameplay; each lasts durationTicks months from the tick it is drawn. Codes are append-only. Multipliers compound and shifts add when cards overlap.

cards.name: Interest-rate hike
cards.text: The Bank of Canada raises its policy rate by a full point. Builders shelve marginal projects.

cards.name: Migration surge
cards.text: More people move to the region than expected. Renter arrivals rise by 30% for a year.

cards.name: Recession
cards.text: Incomes fall 5%, fewer people arrive and tourism softens for a year.

cards.name: Court challenge
cards.text: Hosts challenge the short-term rental rules in court. Enforcement is half as effective for a year.

cards.name: Tourism boom
cards.text: A strong tourist season: short-term rental demand is 25% higher for a year.

cards.name: Wildfire season
cards.text: Smoke keeps tourists away and displaced households seek housing in the region for six months.
